VisuStella Events & Movement Core - Guia Completo para LLMs
=============================================================

SUMARIO
-------
Este documento descreve a estrutura e conteudo da documentacao catalogada do
plugin VisuStella Events & Movement Core para RPG Maker MZ (Tier 1).

O plugin expande eventos com novas funcionalidades, movimento 8-directional,
sprites VS8, switches/variables avancadas, pathfinding, hitbox customizavel,
sincronizacao de movimento, labels/icones sobre eventos, e sistema de spawn/morph.

RELACAO ENTRE AREAS
-------------------

1. CONCEITOS (conceitos/)
   - visao-geral.md: Funcionalidades completas do plugin, plugins de extensao,
     requisitos. Ponto de entrada para entender o escopo do plugin.
   - switches-variables.md: 4 tipos de switches/variables avancadas:
     * <JS> - Executa codigo JavaScript dinamicamente
     * <Self> - Escopo por evento (Self Switches/Variables ilimitados)
     * <Map> - Escopo por mapa (Map Switches/Variables)
     * ((Nome)) - Referencia por string (v1.62+)
     Tags sao mutuamente exclusivas. Inclui todas as script calls.
   - sprites-vs8.md: Tags de filename ($, !, !$, [VS8]), layout completo do
     sprite sheet VS8 (16 blocos de 3 frames), 6 sets de emotes (18 poses),
     weighted random movement.

2. NOTETAGS (notetags/)
   - mapas.md: Notetags para mapas - diagonal movement toggle, region control
     (Allow/Forbid/Dock por tipo), map load common events, save event locations,
     hide/show player/followers, JavaScript on map load/exit.
   - eventos.md: Notetags para eventos (maior arquivo de referencia) - activation
     por regiao/area geometrica/click, movement control (always update, move-only
     regions, move synch com 8 tipos e delay/opacity), encounter control
     (half/none areas com script calls, auto-erase), visual (icon, label com
     range/offset/hue, mirror, scale, shadow, Z-axis custom), hitbox/position
     (extensao em 4 direcoes, location offset, tile expand), pictures em eventos
     (filename, type, max size, scale, offset, wait frames), event templates
     (copy event), e miscellaneous (save location, reset self data, playtest-only,
     random move weight, step patterns).
   - paginas.md: Custom page conditions via comment tags - <Page Conditions>
     com <Conditions Met>, exemplos praticos, comparacao notetag vs comment tag.

3. COMANDOS (comandos/) - Plugin Commands organizados por categoria:
   - auto-movement.md: Auto Movement Events (toggle)
   - call-event.md: Call Event Remote Read (executar pagina remota)
   - dash.md: Dash Enable Toggle
   - event-icon.md: Event/Player Icon Change (Temporary/Forced), Delete, Restore
   - event-label.md: Event Label Refresh, Visible
   - event-location.md: Event Location (Save/Delete/Create), Spawn Event
     (Spawn At X,Y / Region / Terrain Tag, Despawn por ID/X,Y/Region/Terrain/
     Everything), Morph Event (Change/Remove)
   - event-popup.md: Event Popup (Player/Follower/Event/Target Tile) com
     configuracoes completas de fade, offset, scale, angle, arc. Requer MessageCore.
   - event-timer.md: Event Timer (7 comandos), Follower Control (4 comandos),
     Global Switch/Variable (3 comandos), Self Data/Switch/Variable (4 comandos)

4. PARAMETROS (parametros/) - Plugin Parameters organizados por categoria:
   - configuracao-geral.md: Event Template Settings (preloaded maps, templates
     list com JS hooks Pre/Post para Copy/Morph/Spawn)
   - labels-icones.md: Event Label Settings (sprite-based, font, offset, range),
     Event Icon Settings (buffer, blend mode)
   - movement.md: 8-Dir Movement (strict collision, slower diagonals),
     Automatic Movement, Bitmap, Dash (modifier, tilt em radianos), Event Movement
     (random weight, shift Y), Pathfinding, Shadows (Z layer, filename),
     Turn in Place, Vehicle Speeds, VS8 Settings (balloon, icons)
   - regioes-terrain.md: Region Rulings (Allow/Forbid/Dock por tipo),
     Common Event on OK Button (regions 1-255, target tile), Common Event on Touch,
     Terrain Tag Settings (rope)

5. REFERENCIA (referencia/)
   - glossario.md: Definicoes de todos os termos do plugin (Self Switch, VS8,
     Spawn, Morph, Move Synch, Activation Region, etc.)
   - script-calls.md: Todas as script calls (Self/Map Switch/Variable get/set,
     Reference Switch/Variable, Encounter checks) e Move Route Custom Commands
     completos (~40 comandos: Animation, Balloon, Fade, Jump, Move/Crash Move,
     Opacity, Pattern, Pose, Step Toward/Away, Turn To/Away, Teleport, Self Switch/
     Variable). Inclui uso de variaveis ($gameVariables.value(x), \V[x], \SelfVar[x]).
   - troubleshooting.md: 12 problemas comuns e solucoes (shadows, VS8, self
     switches, spawn, popup, pathfinding, move synch, regions, page conditions,
     mobile, diagonal, tags exclusivas)

ORDEM DE LEITURA RECOMENDADA
-----------------------------
1. conceitos/visao-geral.md (entender escopo)
2. conceitos/switches-variables.md (sistema de dados)
3. conceitos/sprites-vs8.md (sistema visual)
4. notetags/mapas.md (configuracao por mapa)
5. notetags/eventos.md (referencia principal de notetags)
6. notetags/paginas.md (condicoes customizadas)
7. comandos/ (consulta por necessidade)
8. parametros/ (consulta por necessidade)
9. referencia/script-calls.md (script calls e move route)
10. referencia/troubleshooting.md (resolucao de problemas)

NOTAS IMPORTANTES
-----------------
- Plugin Tier 1: colocar ABAIXO de plugins de tier 0
- Requer RPG Maker MZ exclusivamente
- Event Popup requer VisuMZ_1_MessageCore
- Shadows NAO aparecem em sprites com prefixo "!"
- Tags <JS>, <Self>, <Map>, <Global> sao mutuamente exclusivas
- Pathfinding usa algoritmo padrao do MZ (nao e otimo)
- Move Route Custom Commands nao aparecem no Preview do editor
- Comandos de spawn sao temporarios por padrao (usar Preserve Spawn)
